_about: Read by scripts/guide-source-links.mjs. A host here is never asked (one reason each); a knownBroken address is accepted until its date, then reported again. 403 and 429 answers need no entry: they are never reported.

blockedHosts.reason: Answers 404 to any script, even for its home page, while every FTC link loaded in a real browser (checked 2026-11-15).

Resets every lychee connection (os error 54) in two runs on 2026-11-15, while the same page loaded (HTTP 200, 11 s) for curl with a browser agent: it drops the checker's TLS fingerprint, not the page.

Pakistan's company registry answers only from inside Pakistan: both pages timed out from GitHub's US runner (run 43694241031, issue #394), while from Pakistan the same day NameSearch.jsp answered 200 in 0.36 s with its real 'Search Company Name' page (2026-11-15).

knownBroken.reason: A correct DOI whose landing site vujs.vn has an expired TLS certificate (2026-11-15); the guide keeps the DOI. Look again on the date.

A correct DOI (Crossref names the paper the guide cites, 2026-11-24) that doi.org forwards to www.tekstilec.si, a host that did not answer: timed out for the weekly check on 2026-11-22 (issue #452) and from Pakistan on 2026-11-24, on http and https. The journal's newer home, journals.uni-lj.si/tekstilec, answers, but its search did not find this 2020 paper; article 12018 there is the same authors' 2021 paper, a different one. The guide keeps the DOI. Look again on the date.
